title: Builder population member removal removes the mapped source member and restores the full population after undo
classificationNote: The exact mapped-plus-orphan Specimen case completed the registered removal lifecycle and the separate Undo restoration assertions. The compact dimension assessments below are derived from the named assertions, native actions, lifecycle checkpoints, and nested request records; the raw report dimension values are retained separately.

browserProcess.runnerWallDurationNote: Not separately measured; do not infer runner wall time from the Playwright durations.

names: bounded independent CDA oracle proves one mapped and one orphan Specimen in the exact authorized project and generation

opening native Rows settings reveals the attached starting collection and mapped member within five seconds
mapped-member click automatically previews an exact base-minus-one candidate with the correct proposal, draft, output, snapshot, and scope bindings

undoAssertion.name: Undo restores the original population and its exact attached selection

usability.evidence: All 27 tracked UI actions passed; native Rows settings, related chooser, remove/cancel/reopen/apply controls and resulting rows were exercised.

correctness.evidence: The independent bounded mapped/orphan oracle and all ten named registered lifecycle checks passed, including exact candidate membership and immutable-base preservation.

persistence.evidence: Cancel preserved base state; reopen returned a fresh scoped candidate; Apply and reload preserved the empty candidate; Undo and restored-state reload returned the original population and attached selection.

performance.evidence: The registered five-second timing check passed; all nine measured lifecycle checkpoints were <= 5,000 ms (maximum 2,382 ms), and the slowest tracked UI action was 982 ms.

dimensionAssessment.method: These assessments are derived from actual named lifecycle evidence. Raw dimensionsAsReported is preserved without alteration; raw persistence/performance were marked untested by the report helper.
